title: 9,000-acre nuclear-powered data center proposed on public lands in Utah
content: The facility calls for 456 small nuclear reactors, nuclear fuel production and nuclear waste storage. On the same day it surfaced, Sen. Ron Wyden introduced legislation that would ban new data centers.

title: Trust is climate infrastructure: What Mauritius teaches us about building truly resilient communities

title: Oil, war and the fate of industrial societies
content: The world teeters on the brink of economic disaster due to energy shortages caused by war. Key oil-producing nations are unable and unwilling to increase output, though prices are high. title: Robert Jensen argues that ‘fewer and less’ is unavoidable. But the future is not fixed
content: It is true that no high-energy society has ever halved its material throughput and existed at that level across generations. But an absent precedent for an unprecedented situation merely tells us the situation is new, not what people will do.
